name: Sine Lab
author: Eric Gao
description: A sine oscillator test bench. Each control moves exactly one audible dimension, so a single-control sweep isolates one thing, and AUX carries the unmodified fundamental as an A/B reference.

controls.label: Partials
controls.description: Fades partials 2, 3, and 4 in one at a time. Fully down is a bare sine.

controls.label: Drive
controls.description: Phase-modulates the fundamental with itself, from a pure sine up to a saw-like buzz.

controls.label: Stretch
controls.description: Detunes the upper partials off the harmonic series, from organ-like to bell-like.

controls.label: Sub
controls.description: Mixes in a sine one octave below the fundamental.

outputs.main: The full partial stack, phase modulation and sub included
outputs.aux: The unmodified fundamental sine, as an A/B reference
